newsitem.title: USA: White House still studying CPI proposals - Tyson.
newsitem.headline: White House still studying CPI proposals - Tyson.

text.p: National Economic Council chief Laura Tyson said Monday the administration is reviewing the Boskin report on the Consumer Price Index, but has reached no conclusions.

"The administration has been indicating that we will give serious study and evalutation to the recent commission's proposals," she said, adding that the White House would also review work done at the Bureau of Labor Statistics and other places.
